meta.name: render-food-product-sizzle
meta.description: Assemble a wordless macro-tabletop food-product sizzle ad from a config — normalize fps and SAR across ~4 photorealistic macro clips (hands tearing, flat lay, bite, box hero), concat them, apply a global anti-AI grain pass (eq plus hqdn3d plus noise), composite the audio (a non-diegetic acoustic music bed plus a couple of short diegetic SFX like a snap and a tear placed at measured cue points, loudnorm), composite a STATIC end card entirely in PIL (real logo PNG plus real product PNG plus a serif heritage headline plus a CTA — never AI-rendered text), and burn optional serif stat-callout pills at beats. This is the FREE deterministic assembly stage (normalized concat plus grain plus music and SFX mix plus PIL end card plus callouts); the macro keyframes, i2v clips, and music bed come from create-image-fal, create-video-fal, and create-music-elevenlabs. Use for the food-product-sizzle format.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据配置自动组装一段约14秒的食品产品广告视频：将4段特写镜头（手撕、平铺、咬、包装）拼接，添加防AI颗粒效果，配上背景音乐和音效，最后用真实Logo和产品图片生成静态结尾卡片。
howto.when: 当你提供4段特写视频片段、背景音乐、音效文件以及真实Logo和产品图片时触发。

say.text: 把结尾卡片换成蓝色背景，CTA写‘立即购买’。
